control.title: Joiner, mover and leaver access process
control.description: Grant access on approved requests, adjust it on role change, and remove it within 24 hours of exit.

implementation_notes: Enforced through our identity provider; access granted by role and reviewed quarterly.
evidence_hint: Access request tickets and offboarding records showing removal time.
acceptance_criteria: Access requests show an approval before access was granted
Leaver records show access removed promptly (date of exit and date of removal)
Samples are from the review period
